name: mkonstan/wp-mcp
description: Self-hosted MCP server for WordPress. Dev-only composer manifest: the plugin ships as plain PHP with no runtime dependencies.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run every suite (integration self-skips when WPMCP_TEST_URL is unset).
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Pure PHP, no WordPress, no Docker.
scripts-descriptions.test:infra: Ask the host WPMCP_TEST_URL points at whether its HTTPS enforcement is real. Excluded from every other run; expected to FAIL on Local by Flywheel and on wp-env, whose proxies forward the client X-Forwarded-Proto. Run it against production.
